items.t: Paracetamol, oral. · Can be used when there are contraindications to Ibuprofen. · Dosage: 15 mg/kg every 6 hours for 5 days.

cautions.t: Maximum 4 g/day in adults (lower in low body weight, chronic alcohol use, malnutrition, liver disease)
Check for paracetamol in combination products

adverse_effects.t: Rare at therapeutic doses, hepatotoxicity in overdose
